messages:
Priya: Quick thread to lock down the policy for compatibility shims + soft-pins. Goal: make migrations predictable for customers who need stability while letting us roll forward.

Omar: Proposal: three migration modes:
- opt-out default: automatic migrations with 7-day notice
- soft-pin: paid 30/60d window where customer stays on pinned model while we run canaries in their tenant
- strict-pin: 90d + SLA, rollback guarantee.

Jie: Bench gating idea: publish per-model baseline slices and three named checks: latency-check, quality-check, drift-check. Each check returns pass/soft-fail/fail. Soft-fail means manual review, fail triggers rollback.

Tess: Ops: canary cadence suggestion for soft-pin tenants: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% over 48h with a 72h regional hold. Must include automated fast-kill and immediate routed fallback to pinned variant.

CanaryBot: info: scheduled canary harness will emit reports to /canary-reports and tag runs with tenant_id when soft-pin enabled.

SalesRep: Commercial asks: need AE one-pager + pricing matrix and clear list of what counts as "customer-visible regression". Customers will expect credit language.

LegalBot: We need metricized definitions in contract: map "customer-visible regression" to named checks (e.g., quality-check fail OR complaint-rate increase >0.5%). I'll draft clause that references the named checks.

Priya: Action items:
- Jie: publish check definitions + example eval slices by Wed
- Tess: rollout policy + fast-kill runbook by Fri
- Omar + SalesRep: draft pricing tiers and AE blurb by next Tue
- LegalBot: contract mapping draft next Tue

Jie: Will also include a per-tenant override flag so enterprise customers can tune thresholds.

Tess: We'll require quantized-only variants to be treated as distinct SKUs unless runtime verifies exact parity. Documenting as an FAQ in AE blurb.

Priya: OK locking this down for RFC next week. Drop :thumbsup: if you agree or call out blockers now.
